technical_data.sms_content: Alert: Unusual activity detected on your corporate device (Device ID: DVC-9823). Reset your password immediately to prevent lockout: https://bit.ly/3yX9zPw

observations: Domain closely mimics legitimate corporate IT support branding
Use of URL shortening (bit.ly) to obscure final destination
Query parameters include personalized device ID and username to increase credibility

technical_data.user_awareness_training_note: This SMS phishing uses AI to insert realistic device IDs and personalized user info, combined with URL shortening to hide malicious links. Users should verify unexpected password reset requests through official channels before clicking links.

samples.detection_method: Deploy mobile threat defense solutions with AI capabilities to detect suspicious URL shortening services and domain impersonation. Correlate device and user behavioral anomalies with reported phishing attempts. Encourage users to report unsolicited password reset SMS and verify via official IT helpdesk.
